theater: 卡累利阿地峽與維堡灣

battle.name: 繼續戰爭
battle.theater: 卡累利阿地峽與維堡灣
battle.brief: 1941年6月25日芬蘭在曼納海姆元帥指揮下重開對蘇戰爭，三年間在卡累利阿地峽拉鋒；1944年蘇軍以維堡—彼得羅扎沃茨克攻勢奪回失地，9月19日莫斯科停戰。卡面T-34坦克是蘇軍反攻主力：1941年先在拉多加卡累利亞作戰，1944年成建制投入突破，芬軍更繳獲數十輛編成第四坦克連。

kit.name: T-34坦克
kit.history: T-34是蘇聯在二戰中期部署的主力中型坦克，以傾斜裝甲與76公厘炮提升生存性與火力，成為蘇軍突破防線的骨幹。

countries: 繼續戰爭（西方稱第二次蘇芬戰爭）自1941年6月25日芬蘭對蘇聯宣戰起，到1944年9月19日簽訂莫斯科停戰協定止，前後三年零三個多月。交戰一方是芬蘭王國與其德國盟友：芬軍由曼納海姆元帥任總司令，國防委員會主持全軍動員，陸軍最多時期編有十六個師，1941年6月動員兵力約五十三萬人，另有德軍駐芬蘭的挪威山地獵兵軍團等部隊協同作戰；德方由迪特爾中將指揮拉普蘭集團軍，目標是打通北極圈內通往基洛夫鐵路的補給線。另一方是蘇聯紅軍，先後以列寧格勒方面軍、沃爾霍夫方面軍與北方集團軍群作戰，1944年維堡攻勢再自卡累利亞、沃羅涅日兩個方面軍與第二波羅的海方面軍抽調部隊增援。芬軍以卡累利阿地峽與東卡累利亞為兩條主軸推進，蘇軍則憑兵源與縱深優勢逐段收復失地。
countriesEn: The Continuation War, called the Second Soviet-Finnish War in the West, ran from Finland's declaration of war on 25 June 1941 to the Moscow Armistice of 19 September 1944, a little over three years. One side was the Kingdom of Finland together with its German ally: the Finnish Army was led by Marshal Mannerheim as commander-in-chief, the national defence council directed the mobilisation, the army numbered sixteen divisions at full strength, and some 530,000 Finns were under arms in June 1941, with German formations such as the Gebirgsjaegerkorps in Finland fighting alongside; on the German side General Dietl commanded the Lapland Force, whose purpose was to open a supply route to the Kirov railway inside the Arctic Circle. The other side was the Red Army, fighting through the Leningrad and Volkhov fronts and later the Northern Group of Forces, and drawing in troops from the Karelian and Voronezh fronts and from the 2nd Baltic Front for the 1944 offensive. The Finns pushed along two main axes, the Karelian Isthmus and East Karelia, while the Soviets, with reserves and manpower to spare, recovered the lost ground section by section.
people: 芬軍的戰略核心是曼納海姆元帥（Carl Gustaf Emil Mannerheim），他自冬季戰爭結束便以國防委員會主席身份主持軍務，1941年6月重掌最高指揮權，堅持把進攻重心放在卡累利阿地峽，並把收復東卡累利亞、進抵斯維里河列為北方戰線的目標。芬蘭總統里斯托·呂蒂（Risto Ryti）在6月25日發表「民族命運」的演說，把反擊與同軸心國並肩作戰綁在一起，議會國防委員會則掌軍需與徵召。蘇聯方面，季莫申科（Semyon Timoshenko）自1941年7月接管列寧格勒方向，其後由梅列茨科夫（Kirill Meretskov）主持列寧格勒方面軍、瓦丘切夫（Nikolai Vatutin）主持沃爾霍夫方面軍，1943年末北方集團軍群成立，更由總參謀部制訂大規模攻勢計畫，華西列夫斯基自1942年起以最高統帥部參謀總長身分統籌全局。1944年夏季的維堡—彼得羅扎沃茨克攻勢中，突擊集團軍的指揮官率領縱深突進。裝備上的關鍵人物則是第四坦克連的指揮官，他率領繳獲的T-34/76與SU-76自走砲加入反擊。德軍方面，迪特爾的集團軍在北線與芬軍並肩作戰至1944年，最終在拉普蘭戰爭中撤退離境。
peopleEn: The strategic core was Marshal Carl Gustaf Emil Mannerheim, who had chaired the defence council since the end of the Winter War and took command again in June 1941, insisting that the Karelian Isthmus carry the main weight of the offensive and that the reconquest of East Karelia up to the Svir river be the northern objective. President Risto Ryti tied Finnish resistance to a German alliance in his address of 25 June on the 'national destiny' of the country, while the parliamentary defence committee handled supply and conscription. On the Soviet side, Semyon Timoshenko took over the Leningrad direction from July 1941; later Kirill Meretskov led the Leningrad Front and Nikolai Vatutin the Volkhov Front; the Northern Group of Forces was formed at the end of 1943, and the General Staff under Stalin, with Vasilevsky as chief of staff from 1942, drew up the grand plan of the great offensives, the commanders of the shock armies leading the deep thrusts of the Vyborg-Petrozavodsk offensive in the summer of 1944. In the equipment field the officer commanding the 4th Tank Company mattered, for he brought captured T-34/76s and SU-76 self-propelled guns into the Finnish counterattack. On the German side, Dietl's force fought beside the Finns in the north until 1944 and then withdrew during the Lapland War.
kits: 卡面這件T-34坦克是蘇軍在繼續戰爭裡的反攻骨幹。蘇聯自1940年起量產T-34/76，1941年出產約六千五百輛，1942年躍升到約二萬四千輛以上，1943年仍維持約二萬四千輛，戰時產量以萬計。它配備76.2毫米F-34戰列炮、五人乘員、傾斜裝甲與約450千瓦汽油機，1941年型在北線先用於拉多加卡累利亞與佩察莫方向，1944年換上新型炮管並大量配屬突擊集團軍，與KV-1重型坦克、SU-76自走砲、76毫米團屬炮、BM-13火箭炮協同，突破正面後以每日上百公里的速度突進縱深。芬軍方面的裝備以火砲為主：1941年出動時只有六輛維克斯六噸坦克、約三十二輛T-26輕型坦克與十餘輛T-28中型坦克，另有繳獲的152毫米M1910/30榴彈炮與122毫米榴彈炮，1944年更從蘇軍手中繳獲數十輛T-34/76，編入第四坦克連，連同六輛SU-76自走砲作戰。德軍提供三號、四號坦克、37毫米反坦克炮、150毫米自行榴彈炮、突擊砲與半履帶車，兩國空軍則以亨舍爾111、Ju 87與Bf 109對上蘇聯的Il-2、Pe-2與雅克戰機。
kitsEn: The T-34 on the card face was the backbone of the Soviet counteroffensive in the Continuation War. The Soviet Union put the T-34/76 into series production from 1940: about 6,500 were built in 1941, output jumped to more than 24,000 in 1942 and stayed near 24,000 in 1943, so that production over the war ran into the tens of thousands. The tank carried a 76.2 mm F-34 gun, a five-man crew, sloped armour and a petrol engine of roughly 450 kW. The 1941 model first served in the north on the Ladoga Karelia and Petsamo axes; in 1944, fitted with the new gun barrel, it was fielded in large numbers with the shock armies, working with KV-1 heavy tanks, SU-76 self-propelled guns, 76 mm regimental guns and BM-13 rocket launchers, and once the front was broken the formations pushed deep at up to a hundred kilometres a day. Finnish equipment was overwhelmingly artillery: at the start of the offensive Finland had only six Vickers 6-ton tanks, roughly thirty-two T-26 light tanks and a dozen T-28 medium tanks, together with captured 152 mm M1910/30 and 122 mm howitzers; in 1944 it seized several dozen T-34/76s from the Soviet Army and formed them into a 4th Tank Company together with six SU-76 self-propelled guns. Germany supplied Panzer III and Panzer IV tanks, 37 mm anti-tank guns, 150 mm self-propelled howitzers, assault guns and half-tracks, while the two air forces matched Heinkel 111s, Ju 87s and Bf 109s against the Soviet Il-2, Pe-2 and Yaks.
tactics: 芬軍的戰術核心是森林條件下的分割包圍，芬語稱「motti」，即以小分隊利用林間小徑切割敵軍縱深，再以炮火封鎖退路，形成口袋殲滅；冬季戰爭所得的經驗在1941年被系統發揚，攻勢前先以偵察營滲透，炮兵集中射擊，再由工兵排雷開路。1941年6月25日，芬軍以十六個師在西起孔坎內維線至東至斯維里河約三百公里的正面同時發動攻勢，卡累利阿地峽方向由兩個軍團實施鉗形攻擊，北方則沿薩拉線向楚克湖推進，結果北方戰線失利而地峽得手，八月二十九日攻入維堡。1944年蘇軍作戰方式完全相反：一次投入逾百萬兵力、上千輛坦克與數千門火炮，連續數日實施縱深突破，以絕對火力配比撕開正面，再以快速集群向縱深突進，每日推進數十公里。八月伊洛曼齊戰役中，芬軍第四軍反擊得手，切斷蘇軍第三十二集團軍一部，卻已無力扭轉大局。
tacticsEn: Finnish doctrine rested on encirclement in the forest, known in Finnish as the 'motti': small detachments used tracks through the trees to cut enemy columns, then artillery sealed the exits and the pocket was destroyed. Lessons of the Winter War were systematised in 1941, with reconnaissance infiltration first, massed artillery fire next, and engineer pioneers clearing minefields ahead of the infantry. On 25 June 1941 sixteen divisions attacked along a front of roughly 300 kilometres, from the Kongcane line in the west to the Svir river in the east: two corps drove a pincer on the Karelian Isthmus while the northern columns pushed towards Lake Chuqa along the Salla road. The north failed and the isthmus succeeded, and Vyborg fell on 29 August. In 1944 the Soviet method was the exact opposite: more than a million men, a thousand tanks and thousands of guns committed at once, several days of continuous breakthrough, the front torn open by an overwhelming ratio of firepower, and then fast tank groups racing into the depths, making good tens of kilometres a day. At Ilomantsi in August the Finnish IV Corps scored a counterstroke that cut part of the Soviet 32nd Army, but it came too late to change the outcome.
data: 可查的數字大致勾勒出這場戰爭的規模。時間上，1941年6月25日開戰，1944年9月19日簽訂莫斯科停戰協定，前後三年零三個多月。兵力上，芬軍最多時期約五十三萬人，編十六個師；德軍留在芬蘭境內者約二十五至三十萬人；蘇軍在維堡—彼得羅扎沃茨克攻勢中宣稱投入逾百萬人、上千輛坦克與數千門火炮，實際亦自卡累利亞與沃羅涅日兩個方面軍及第二波羅的海方面軍調兵。推進距離上，芬軍1941年在卡累利阿地峽自北向南推進約三百五十公里，八月二十九日攻下維堡；蘇軍1944年六月二十日發動攻勢，一週之內即把戰線推回舊界。裝備產量上，T-34/76於1941年出產約六千五百輛，1942年約二萬四千輛以上，1943年約二萬四千輛，1944年起T-34/85與改型並行。傷亡上，各家統計互有出入，一般記芬軍陣亡約六萬人上下，蘇軍陣亡約十二萬至十三萬人，其中蘇方數字多指作戰陣亡而非全部損失。停戰後芬蘭仍須支付賠償、割讓佩察莫並租借波爾卡拉半島。史載有限之處，如各次戰役的逐日傷亡與各師展開序列，多數只能依概略記載推想。
dataEn: The available figures sketch the scale of the war. In time: it began on 25 June 1941 and ended with the Moscow Armistice on 19 September 1944, a little over three years. In men: Finland mobilised about 530,000 at the peak in sixteen divisions, while Germany kept between 250,000 and 300,000 men in Finland; for the Vyborg-Petrozavodsk offensive the Soviets claimed more than a million men, a thousand tanks and several thousand guns, drawing troops from the Karelian and Voronezh fronts and the 2nd Baltic Front. In distance: the Finns advanced some 350 kilometres down the Karelian Isthmus in 1941 and took Vyborg on 29 August, while the Soviet offensive launched on 20 June 1944 pushed the line back behind the old border within a week. In production: about 6,500 T-34/76s were built in 1941, more than 24,000 in 1942, some 24,000 in 1943, and from 1944 the T-34/85 and rebuilt variants were produced side by side. In losses: the sources differ, but Finland is usually given roughly 60,000 military dead and the Soviet Union something between 120,000 and 130,000, the Soviet figure referring to battle deaths rather than to all losses. After the armistice Finland still had to pay reparations, cede Petsamo and lease the Porkkala peninsula. Where the record is thin, as in daily casualty returns and the exact deployment sequences of individual divisions, only rough figures can be reconstructed.
cause: 繼續戰爭的起因可以分成三層。第一層是冬季戰爭的餘痛：1940年3月的莫斯科和約割走芬蘭約百分之九的國土、卡累利阿地峽與佩察莫，芬蘭軍政界普遍認為收復失地理所當然，國防開支一度激增到國家支出的一半左右。第二層是國際格局的轉折：1939年8月的莫洛托夫—里賓特洛甫條約把芬蘭劃入蘇聯勢力範圍，1941年6月22日德軍發動巴巴羅薩行動後，蘇聯空襲維堡等城市，芬蘭以此為由宣布作戰，軸心國則承諾以物資與軍事裝備回報。第三層是領導層的目標分歧：總統里斯托·呂蒂期望以參戰換取芬蘭的安全與自主，曼納海姆則把收復東卡累利亞、進抵斯維里河列為北方戰線的軍事目標；北方戰線失利後德軍仍推動芬軍向彼得羅扎沃茨克方向延伸，反過來把芬蘭更緊地綁在軸心國的車軸上。芬蘭並非自願全面倒向德國，而是在領土、民族與安全三重壓力下做出的軍事選項。
causeEn: The origins of the Continuation War can be read on three levels. First, the sting of the Winter War: the Moscow Peace Treaty of March 1940 had taken about 9 per cent of Finnish territory, the Karelian Isthmus and Petsamo, and the Finnish political class came to treat reconquest as a matter of right, with defence spending pushed up to around half of national expenditure. Second, the international turn: the Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact of August 1939 assigned Finland to the Soviet sphere, and after Operation Barbarossa was launched on 22 June 1941 the Soviet air raids on Vyborg and other towns gave the Finnish government its pretext, the Axis promising material and military aid in return. Third, a divergence of aims inside the Finnish leadership: President Risto Ryti hoped that joining the war would buy security and autonomy for Finland, while Mannerheim set the reconquest of East Karelia up to the Svir river as the military objective of the northern front. After the failure in the north the Germans pressed the Finns further towards Petrozavodsk, which in turn tied Finland more tightly to the Axis. Finland was not a free choice of full alignment; it was a military option taken under combined pressure of territory, nation and security.
impact: 繼續戰爭的直接後果是芬蘭退回1940年的邊界：東卡累利亞與佩察莫割讓蘇聯，波爾卡拉半島被租借十五年，芬蘭須支付賠償，並在條約中承認自己是德國的盟友。更深遠的影響是芬軍必須自行驅逐駐紮境內的德軍，1944年9月起爆發拉普蘭戰爭，芬德同盟徹底破裂，芬蘭退出軸心國；西方盟國視其為敵國，英國與紐西蘭在1944年12月對芬宣戰，雖未實際參戰，其後亦相繼撤銷宣戰。蘇聯則藉此鞏固北極圈的門戶，取得維堡與通往基洛夫鐵路的西側基地，把卡累利亞納入版圖，北方自此不再是可資援應的外圍。從軍事技術史看，T-34在這三年裡由嶄新裝備變成經驗成熟的體系，傾斜裝甲與大威力戰列炮的組合被後來的坦克設計吸收；從政治史看，這場戰爭是芬蘭「芬蘭化」道路的起點，戰後芬蘭以民主化、中立與對蘇友好換取生存空間，並於1948年簽訂蘇芬友好合作條約。曼納海姆於1944年12月辭去軍職，1946年當選芬蘭總統。
impactEn: The direct result was that Finland fell back to the borders of 1940: East Karelia and Petsamo were ceded, the Porkkala peninsula was leased for fifteen years, and Finland had to pay reparations and acknowledge in the treaty that it had been Germany's ally. The deeper consequence was that the Finns had to drive German troops off their own soil. From September 1944 the Lapland War broke out, the Finnish-German alliance collapsed and Finland left the Axis; the Western Allies treated it as an enemy state, Britain and New Zealand declaring war on Finland in December 1944 without ever fighting there and later annulling those declarations. The Soviet Union consolidated its grip on the Arctic approaches, took Vyborg and the ground west of the Kirov railway, and drew Karelia inside its borders, so that the north ceased to be a flank it could leave exposed. In the history of military technology, the T-34 matured over those three years from a new design into a settled system, and the pairing of sloped armour with a high-velocity gun was absorbed by later tank design. In political history, the war was the start of the road towards 'Finlandisation': democracy, neutrality and friendship with Moscow in exchange for room to exist, formalised in the Finno-Soviet treaty of 1948. Mannerheim resigned the command in December 1944 and was elected President of Finland in 1946.
result: 結局是蘇軍全面收復失地。1944年六月二十日，蘇軍在維堡—彼得羅扎沃茨克方向發動縱深突破，芬軍在卡累利阿地峽的抵抗在數日內崩解，維堡於同日易手，芬軍退守拉多加湖以東的拉多加卡累利亞，七月蘇軍佔領彼得羅扎沃茨克並打通通往斯維里河的通道；八月伊洛曼齊一役芬軍雖有反擊戰果，仍未能扭轉戰局。八月下旬蘇軍越過舊界進入芬蘭本土，芬蘭政府提出辭呈，曼納海姆力主議和。九月十九日芬蘇在莫斯科簽訂停戰協定，芬軍退回1940年邊界，割讓佩察莫，租借波爾卡拉，並承諾在十個月內把德軍逐出芬蘭。九月十九日至翌年四月，芬軍在拉普蘭以殘酷手段清剿德軍，雙方均付出慘重代價，這場衝突成為芬德同盟的終章。戰爭至此結束，芬蘭以中立者的姿態留在兩大集團之間，而卡面上的T-34，則是蘇軍自此以後四十年陸軍骨幹的起點。
resultEn: The outcome was a full Soviet recovery. On 20 June 1944 the Red Army launched its deep breakthrough on the Vyborg-Petrozavodsk axis; Finnish resistance on the Karelian Isthmus collapsed within days, Vyborg changed hands on the same day, and the Finns withdrew to Ladoga Karelia east of Lake Ladoga. In July the Soviets took Petrozavodsk and opened the road to the Svir. At Ilomantsi in August the Finns won a counterstroke, but it could not turn the campaign. In late August the Red Army crossed the old border into Finnish territory, the government tendered its resignation and Mannerheim pressed for an armistice. On 19 September Finland and the Soviet Union signed the Moscow Armistice: Finnish troops pulled back behind the 1940 border, Petsamo was ceded, Porkkala was leased, and Finland undertook to expel the German forces within ten months. Between September 1944 and April 1945 the Finns hunted the Germans out of Lapland at brutal cost on both sides, and that conflict became the final chapter of the Finnish-German alliance. The war ended there, leaving Finland standing neutral between the two great blocs, and the T-34 on the card face was the beginning of the armoured backbone that would carry the Soviet Army for the next forty years.
